crossRefs.note: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

translations.web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
translations.bsb: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand and no longer reply?
translations.kjv: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered
translations.asv: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?
